bifrost: springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs (app-internal card and editor); springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs (shell-internal store); springboard/src/shell/share/mod.rs (vCard item)
summary: Apple's Contacts UI is three view controllers or controls: a contact viewer, a contact picker, and a limited-access button. BifrOSt has no SDK viewer or editor view, and no SDK picker that returns a chosen contact to an app. Apps reach the contact store through the SDK contacts module behind a per-app access grant, and the Contacts app's picker model drives its Add People flow. The card and editor stay private to the Contacts app.

features.bifrost: springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs (draw_detail, open_detail, show_contact); wired: springboard/ui/src/contact_card.rs (wired in springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs: card_entry, card_rows, value_slot)
features.note: The Contacts app shows a contact card, but only inside that app. No SDK view controller exists for other apps to display a contact. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.
Editing exists in the Contacts app only. Saving happens when the form is done, and Cancel leaves the contact unchanged. Not exposed as an SDK API.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/contact_picker.rs (wired: Add People picker in springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs, Picker at line 1063, via bifrost_app::controls::contact_picker)
features.note: The picker model is wired into the Contacts app. An app cannot ask the user to choose a contact and receive the result: no SDK picker returns a choice, and the share picker only lists apps. Not yet tested on the VM or Midget.

features.apple: CNContactStore-backed UI (implicit in the framework's contact views)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/contacts.rs (access, request, fetch, save); springboard/src/shell/services/contacts.rs (contacts service: per-app grant, fetch by keys and query); springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs (search at line 126, used by the Search panel)
features.note: Apps read and save contacts through the contacts service, behind a per-app grant (every contact, a picked set read-only, or none). The Search panel searches the same store in the shell.

features.feature: Sharing a contact as a card
features.apple: CNContact share via UI (no dedicated Contacts UI class)
features.note: The shell builds a vCard 3.0 for a contact and the share menu sends it. Apps cannot create a contact card item themselves.

The limited state and its picked set exist in the model and the service, so an app can see that it has a limited grant. No button or sheet draws it yet, so the person cannot change a limited grant from the app.

gaps: No SDK contact picker (CNContactPicker or CNContactPickerViewController equivalent) that returns the chosen contact to an app.
No SDK contact viewer or editor view that other apps can embed; the card and editor are private to contacts-desktop.
No access sheet or limited-access button; the person cannot change a contacts grant from the app or from Settings yet.
